questions.stem: 對於熱衷追星的人來說，偶像代言的商品長久以來一直被視為品質的保證。
questions.answer: For those who are big fans of pop stars, the products their idols endorse have long been seen as a guarantee of quality.
accepted_answers: For those who love following celebrities, products endorsed by their idols have long been regarded as a guarantee of good quality.
For those who are crazy about stars, the products that their idols promote have always been considered a guarantee of quality.

patterns: 完成式被動（have long been p.p.）

questions.stem: 在人人都能上網推銷商品的時代，青少年更容易衝動購物，這讓許多父母擔憂。
questions.answer: In an age when anyone can promote products online, teenagers are more likely to buy things on impulse, which worries many parents.
accepted_answers: In an era where everyone can sell products on the Internet, teenagers are more inclined to buy things on impulse, which makes many parents worried.
In an age in which anyone can advertise products online, teenagers are more likely to shop on impulse, which worries a lot of parents.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which 指前面整件事）

1.explanation_zh: 「對於…的人來說」用 For those who + V …；「追星」可寫 be big fans of pop stars／follow celebrities。「偶像代言的商品」是名詞＋修飾語，英文寫 the products (that) their idols endorse 或 products endorsed by their idols。「長久以來一直被視為」用完成式被動 have long been seen/regarded as（主詞 products 是複數，用 have）；「品質的保證」是 a guarantee of quality。
evidence: 對於熱衷追星的人來說
1.strategy_zh: 「長久以來一直被…」→ have/has long been + p.p.；先確定主詞單複數再選 have 或 has。
hints: 切成四段：對於熱衷追星的人來說／偶像代言的商品／長久以來一直被視為／品質的保證
標的詞彙：star（明星）、idol（偶像）、endorse（代言）、product（商品）、guarantee（保證）、quality（品質）
句型框架：For those who + V …, S + have long been seen as + a + N + of + N

2.explanation_zh: 「在…的時代」修飾時間名詞 age／era，子句「人人都能上網推銷商品」結構完整，用關係副詞 when（或 where、in which）：In an age when anyone can promote products online。「更容易」是可能性高，用 be more likely to V；「衝動購物」用 buy things on impulse。「這讓許多父母擔憂」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which worries many parents（which 後面的動詞用單數）。
evidence: 在人人都能上網推銷商品的時代
2.strategy_zh: 「在…的時代／那天」→ N(時間) + when + S + V；「更容易…」→ be more likely to V。
hints: 切成四段：在人人都能上網推銷商品的時代／青少年更容易／衝動購物／這讓許多父母擔憂
標的詞彙：age（時代）、promote（推銷）、product（商品）、online（在網路上）、teenager（青少年）、impulse（衝動）、worry（使擔憂）、parent（父母）
句型框架：In an age when + S + V …, S + be more likely to + V …, which + V + O

references: For those who are big fans of pop stars, the products their idols endorse have long been seen as a guarantee of quality.
For those who love following celebrities, products endorsed by their idols have long been regarded as a guarantee of good quality.
For those who are crazy about stars, the products that their idols promote have always been considered a guarantee of quality.

patterns.label_zh: 對於…的人而言（For those who）
patterns.frame: For those who + V …, S + V …
patterns.zh_trigger: 對於熱衷追星的人來說

patterns.label_zh: 完成式被動（長久以來一直被…）

parts.zh: 對於熱衷追星的人來說
accepted: For those who are big fans of pop stars
For those who love following celebrities
For those who are crazy about stars
For those who are big fans of celebrities

common_errors.right: For those who are big fans of pop stars
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「追星」是熱衷支持明星，不是字面上「追逐星星」；用 be big fans of pop stars／follow celebrities。

common_errors.wrong: For those who is a big fan of pop stars
common_errors.right: For those who are big fans of pop stars
common_errors.explanation_zh: those 是複數，who 子句的動詞用 are，名詞也用複數 fans。

accepted: the products that their idols promote
the products endorsed by their idols

common_errors.explanation_zh: 這裡的主詞是「商品」，要寫 the products (that) their idols endorse；寫成 their idols endorse products 會多出一組主詞＋動詞。
商品是「被」代言，用過去分詞 endorsed。
「被視為」是被動，完成式被動要有 been：have been seen as。
主詞 products 是複數，助動詞用 have。
「品質的保證」用 a guarantee of quality；用所有格 the quality's 意思變成「品質所擁有的保證」。
as 後面接名詞片語；「保證」在這裡是名詞，要加冠詞 a，再用 of 連接 quality。

traps.literal_error: For those who chase stars, the products their idols endorse …
traps.explanation_zh: 「追星」是熱衷支持明星，用 be big fans of pop stars／follow celebrities；chase stars 是字面直譯。

traps.literal_error: … the products their idols endorse have long seen as a guarantee of quality.
traps.explanation_zh: 「長久以來一直被」同時要表現完成式與被動：have long been seen as，been 不能漏。

bonus.text: For devoted fans, a product endorsed by their idol has long been taken as proof of its quality.
bonus.explanation_zh: devoted fans（死忠粉絲）、be taken as proof of（被當成…的證明）比 be seen as a guarantee 更道地。

1.restructuring_zh: 主詞「偶像代言的商品」要改成名詞在前：the products (that) their idols endorse；「長久以來一直被視為」不必逐字譯「一直」，用 have long been seen as 一次表達。

references: In an age when anyone can promote products online, teenagers are more likely to buy things on impulse, which worries many parents.
In an era where everyone can sell products on the Internet, teenagers are more inclined to buy things on impulse, which makes many parents worried.
In an age in which anyone can advertise products online, teenagers are more likely to shop on impulse, which worries a lot of parents.

patterns.label_zh: 關係副詞 when（在…的時代）
patterns.frame: In an age when + S + V …, S + V …
patterns.zh_trigger: 在人人都能上網推銷商品的時代

patterns.label_zh: 非限定關係子句（which 指前面整件事）

parts.zh: 在人人都能上網推銷商品的時代
accepted: In an age when anyone can promote products online
In an era where everyone can sell products on the Internet
In an age in which anyone can advertise products online
In an age when everyone can promote products online

common_errors.wrong: In an age which anyone can promote products online
common_errors.right: In an age when anyone can promote products online
common_errors.explanation_zh: 子句「人人都能上網推銷商品」結構完整，缺的是時間，用關係副詞 when（＝in which），不能只用 which。

common_errors.wrong: In the age of everyone can promote products online
common_errors.right: In an age when everyone can promote products online
common_errors.explanation_zh: 介系詞 of 後面不能接完整子句；要用 when 引導形容詞子句修飾 age。
「更容易（做某事）」指可能性，用 be more likely to V；teenagers are easier to … 的意思變成「青少年比較容易被…」。
泛指青少年用複數 teenagers。
be more likely to 後面要接動詞片語：buy things on impulse／shop on impulse；impulsive buy 詞性不對。
「一時衝動」的固定搭配是 on impulse。

accepted: which worries a lot of parents

common_errors.wrong: this makes many parents worry about
common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號後要用 which 指前面整件事；worry about 後面還缺受詞。
which 指前面整件事（單數），動詞用 makes。

traps.literal_error: … teenagers are more likely to impulse shopping, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「衝動購物」在 be more likely to 後面要用動詞片語 buy things on impulse；impulse shopping 是名詞，不能接在 to 後面。

traps.zh: 在人人都能上網推銷商品的時代
traps.literal_error: In everyone can promote products online age, teenagers …
traps.explanation_zh: 修飾「時代」的是一整個子句，英文先寫 In an age，再用 when 引導子句放在後面。

bonus.text: In an age when anyone can peddle products online, teenagers are increasingly prone to impulse buying, a trend that has left many parents uneasy.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用同位語 a trend that … 取代 which，peddle（兜售）、be prone to（容易…）、uneasy（不安的）讓句子更精準。

2.restructuring_zh: 「在…的時代」要先寫 In an age，再用 when 子句修飾；句尾「這讓…擔憂」用 , which worries … 接在後面，不另起一句。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.1.patterns[1]: gp-perfect-passive 通常對應句構 PERF（目前 code=PASS）

1.translation: For those who are enthusiastic about following celebrities, products endorsed by their idols have long been regarded as a guarantee of quality.
1.explanation_zh: 「熱衷追星的人」用 those who are enthusiastic about following celebrities；「偶像代言的商品」用過去分詞 endorsed by 後位修飾；「長久以來一直被視為」用現在完成式被動 have long been regarded as。

2.translation: In an age when anyone can promote products online, teenagers are more likely to make impulse purchases, which worries many parents.
2.explanation_zh: 「在……的時代」用 an age when 關係副詞子句；「更容易」譯 are more likely to；「衝動購物」譯 make impulse purchases；「這讓許多父母擔憂」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 which worries many parents。

issues_zh: 建議（不影響判定）：第 1 部分可補「For those who are enthusiastic about following celebrities／stars」；參考譯文 0 的 pop stars 比「追星」窄一點，但可接受。

1.translation: For those who are passionate about following celebrities, products endorsed by idols have long been regarded as a guarantee of quality.
1.explanation_zh: 「熱衷追星的人」譯成 those who are passionate about following celebrities；「偶像代言的商品」用過去分詞後置修飾 products endorsed by idols；「長久以來一直被視為」用現在完成式被動 have long been regarded as；「品質的保證」是 a guarantee of quality。

2.translation: In an era when everyone can promote products online, teenagers are more likely to buy things on impulse, which worries many parents.
2.explanation_zh: 「在……的時代」用 in an era when …；「推銷商品」用 promote products；「更容易」用 be more likely to；「衝動購物」用 buy on impulse；「這讓許多父母擔憂」用 which 非限定關係子句。

issues_zh: 輕微：「熱衷追星」我譯成 are passionate about following celebrities，句型與語意都對，但第 1 部分 accepted 只列 big fans of／love following／crazy about，沒有 passionate about 這種最貼近字面的寫法；products endorsed by idols 也少了 their。
